products.ingestionNotes: Status is 'discovered' until a curator fetches the file, verifies the SHA-256 against the PDS label, and runs the ingestion pipeline (Administration → Data products → Trigger ingestion run, then Approve). The reader (science/moonnav_science/dem.py) is product-agnostic: any PDS3 polar-stereographic LOLA IMG with the required label keywords is accepted. A unit test (science/tests/test_geometry_and_terrain.py::TestHigherResDem) exercises the reader against a synthetic 5 m product to prove the code path is ready.
